library
  api (backend, hono)
    authors: Author
      GET /authors
      GET /authors/[id]
      POST /authors
      PATCH /authors/[id]
      DELETE /authors/[id]
      GET /authors/[id]/books
    books: Book
      GET /books
      GET /books/[id]
      POST /books
      PATCH /books/[id]
      DELETE /books/[id]
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
    /authors: load authors from authors, list of AuthorCard(authors)
    /authors/[id]: load author from authors by id, AuthorView(author)
    /books: load books from books, BookShelf(books)
    /books/new: form books.create, then /books
    AuthorCard(author: Author): card
      shows: author.name, author.born
      links to /authors/[id]
      deletes via authors.delete
    AuthorView(author: Author): detail
      shows: author.name, author.born, author.books as chips
    BookShelf(books: list of Book): table
      shows: books.title, books.author, books.genre, books.published, books.in_print
      books.author links to /authors/[id]
  data (2 entities)
    Author
    Book
